guide_examples_option_description_4.message: A section can enter a group so that its options can be read relative to it.

guide_examples_standard_description_1.message: Reference an entry by name to insert its value.

guide_examples_standard_description_2.message: Single braces insert the value as-is, whereas double braces HTML-escape it.

guide_examples_standard_description_3.message: Entries can be freely combined with any surrounding text.

guide_examples_standard_description_4.message: Wrap a boolean entry in a section to render its contents only when it is true.

guide_introduction_case_sensitivity_text.message: Entry names are matched case-insensitively, so `{browserName}`, `{browsername}` and `{BrowserName}` are all equivalent. This guide shows each name in camel case purely for readability, so you are free to write them however you find clearest.
guide_introduction_case_sensitivity_text.description: Paragraph of the "Case sensitivity" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_case_sensitivity_titl.description: Title of the "Case sensitivity" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_comments_text.message: Anything inside `{!...}` is omitted from the output, which is handy for annotating a long template.
guide_introduction_comments_text.description: Paragraph of the "Comments" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_comments_title.description: Title of the "Comments" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_dot_notation_text.message: Properties of an object entry can be reached directly without opening a section, so `{cookies.session_id}` is equivalent to `{#cookies}{session_id}{/cookies}`.
guide_introduction_dot_notation_text.description: Paragraph of the "Dot notation" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_dot_notation_title.description: Title of the "Dot notation" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_escaping_text_1.message: Values are inserted exactly as they are by default, which is usually what you want when producing Markdown, plain text or a URL.
guide_introduction_escaping_text_1.description: 1st paragraph of the "Escaping" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_escaping_text_2.message: To HTML-escape a value instead, double the braces or prefix the name with an ampersand, so both `{{title}}` and `{&title}` turn a title of `Example & Domain` into `Example & Domain`. This is the opposite of standard Mustache, which escapes by default.
guide_introduction_escaping_text_2.description: 2nd paragraph of the "Escaping" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_escaping_title.description: Title of the "Escaping" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_inverted_sections_tex.message: An inverted section opens with `{^name}` and renders its contents only when the entry is absent, false, or an empty list, which makes it ideal for providing a fallback.
guide_introduction_inverted_sections_tex.description: Paragraph of the "Inverted sections" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_inverted_sections_tit.description: Title of the "Inverted sections" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_lead_message.message: Templates are written using a logic-less syntax based on Mustache, where anything inside curly braces is replaced with a value taken from the current page. The pages that follow list every value available to you.
guide_introduction_lead_message.description: Lead paragraph of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_lists_objects_values_.message: Referencing a list or object without a section renders it as a comma-separated list — of its items for a list, or of its property values for an object. Use a section whenever you need to control the separator or the layout.
guide_introduction_lists_objects_values_.description: Paragraph of the "Lists and objects as values" section of the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_notes_text_2.message: Entries marked as deprecated continue to work so that existing templates keep rendering, but they may be removed in a future release and should be replaced where possible.
guide_introduction_notes_text_2.description: 2nd paragraph of the notes alert on the introduction guide page.

guide_introduction_notes_text_3.message: Values are only computed when a template actually references them, so listing many entries has no cost unless they are used.
